chunks: Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:
"There is no salat (prayer) for one who does not attend the prayer from among the neighbors of the mosque, except one who is ill or preoccupied."

key_terms.صَلَاةَ: salat (prayer), here referring to the prayer whose communal attendance is being emphasized
key_terms.مَشْغُولٌ: one who is occupied or prevented by a valid preoccupation
key_terms.يَشْهَدُ: to attend or be present at

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say about neighbors of the mosque missing congregational salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith stresses the importance of attending congregational salat (prayer) for those who live near the mosque. It indicates a strong obligation or emphasis upon mosque-neighbors to be present, while exempting those who are ill or genuinely occupied.
